equivalent.description: Newline between words becomes a single space
Whitespace around parentheses and operators is insignificant
Comments are removed by normalizer (block and line)
Mixed whitespace collapses correctly around operators

notEquivalent.description: Return + newline is significant (must not be collapsed)
Whitespace changes inside string literals are significant
Whitespace changes inside template literals are significant
Comment removal may remove a required separator (return/value)
Operator change must be detected as non-equivalent
